title: Phaedo Fingerprint
description: A structured, layered model of how a subject thinks, communicates, decides, and works (Phaedo Protocol v0.1 §4). The decrypted vault payload; the ciphertext envelope (§7) is the only form transported.

layers.description: The eight canonical layers: surface, behavioral, creative, domain_and_expertise, temporal_and_context, collaboration_and_relationship, decision_and_risk, big_picture. Each is independently selectable and encryptable.

consult_policies.description: Optional consultation guardrails carried INSIDE the fingerprint so they travel with it across every transport (the portable home for authored policies; see consultation-policy.schema.json).

phaedo_consult_policies.description: Optional portable consultation guardrails — see consultation-policy.schema.json.
